note: Decoded payload of a FICTIONAL access token. Not a real token: no header, no signature, synthetic IDs only. Never paste a live token into a website, chat, file or log.

what_the_server_checks.iss and tid: Built-in authentication: the token comes from the workshop tenant.
what_the_server_checks.aud: Built-in authentication: the token was issued for THIS MCP API (client ID or api:// URI), not for Microsoft Graph.
what_the_server_checks.azp: Built-in authorization policy: the calling app is an allowed client (VS Code or Azure CLI).
what_the_server_checks.exp and nbf: Built-in authentication: the token is valid now.
what_the_server_checks.scp: The client app may act for Alice on this API (delegated). It says nothing about what Alice may do.
what_the_server_checks.roles: What Alice may do: read and write tools. Enforced per tool from module 04 onward.
